root_cause_analysis.conclusion: The extern symbol-resolution fix (PR #25) is confirmed working -- reconnectWithBackoff's real cross-file definition IS correctly resolved and included. The remaining gap is that the Context Engine's call-graph traversal is 1-hop only (direct callees), not transitive -- the contract constant lives 2 hops away (callee-of-callee). This is a distinct, newly-identified limitation, not a regression of the PR #25 fix.
root_cause_analysis.recommendation: Worth a design discussion (token-budget/noise tradeoffs of deeper traversal) in a future session -- not attempted as a hot-fix here, per the bug-fix policy's smallest-fix discipline.
